chunks: Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Ibn Abī Naṣr, who said:
I said to Abū al-Ḥasan al-Riḍā عليه السلام: "When the Imam dies, by what is the one after him recognized?"

He said: "The Imam has signs. Among them is that he is the eldest child of his father, and that merit and the bequest are in him, and that the riders come and say, 'To whom did so-and-so bequeath?' Then it is said, 'To so-and-so.' And the weapon among us is like the Ark among the Children of Israel; the Imamate is with the weapon wherever it may be."

key_terms.التَّابُوتِ: the Ark, used here as an analogy for a sign of divine authority
key_terms.السِّلَاحُ: the weapon as a sign accompanying rightful Imamate
key_terms.الْإِمَامَةُ: the office and authority of the Imam
key_terms.الْفَضْلُ: special merit and excellence found in the Imam
key_terms.الْوَصِيَّةُ: the bequest or explicit designation of succession
key_terms.عَلَامَاتٌ: distinct signs by which the Imam is recognized

ai.seo_question: How is the next Imam recognized after the death of the previous Imam?
ai.summary: This hadith explains signs by which the succeeding Imam is recognized after the passing of the previous Imam. It identifies indicators such as seniority among the father's children, possession of excellence and explicit designation, and the symbolic transmission of the weapon, which is likened to the Ark among Banī Isrāʾīl as a sign of rightful Imamate.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Abu Nasr who said,
‘I said to Abu Al-Hassan Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup>, ‘When the Imam<sup>asws</sup> passes away, by what does he<sup>asws</sup> recognise the one<sup>asws</sup> who is to be after him<sup>asws</sup>?’

So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘For the Imam<sup>asws</sup> there are certain signs – from these is that he<sup>asws</sup> would happen to be the eldest son of his<sup>asws</sup> father, and there would happen to be the merit in him<sup>asws</sup>, and the bequest, and the riders would come, so they would be saying, ‘To whom has it (Imamate) been bequeathed?’ So it could be said, ‘To so and so’. And the weapons among us<sup>asws</sup> are at the status of the Ark among the Children of Israel. The Imamate would happen to be with the weapons, wherever they may be’.
en.sarwar: 1. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn abu Nasr who has said that he asked abu al-Hassan al-Rida (a.s.) the following.
“When the Imam dies through what means one would know the succeeding Imam (a.s.)?”

He said, “For the Imam there are certain signs. Of such sign one is that he must be the eldest son of his father. The will and excellence must be found in him and when people come to ask who is appointed the executor of the will in answer it can be said that so and so is appointed the executor of the will. The Armament with us is like the Ark in the Israelites. Imamat (leadership with Divine authority) is always with the Armament wherever it may go.”
